message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: a police auxiliary (协警) who is a state functionary, helps a drug dealer hide seized drugs, then later flushes one bag, confesses, returns another bag. This is abuse of official position to conceal drug evidence. The relevant Chinese criminal law article: Article 381? Actually, "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power, dereliction of duty) maybe. The description: "国家机关工作人员徇私舞弊，帮助犯罪分子隐匿、转移、毁灭犯罪证据，或者为其提供帮助的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑。" That's article 381 of Criminal Law (formerly 381). The text says "二款" maybe refers to second paragraph. So the crime is "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power to conceal evidence). Also possibly "帮助毒品犯罪分子" but the specific crime is "徇私舞弊罪". In examples, they label as "容留他人吸毒" etc. For this case, they likely label as "徇私舞弊罪". Could also be "帮助犯罪分子隐匿、转移、毁灭犯罪证据罪". That's the same. So answer: [罪名]徇私舞弊<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: He also handled drug (but not trafficking). He concealed drug evidence, not possession. So only that.

Thus final answer.
